faq.headline: Questions.
faq.subtext: What people ask before they buy.

items.a: The Landing Page Motion Pack is a one-time purchase of {price}. You pay once and keep all {packCount} components; nothing renews and nothing expires.

items.q: Can I use it on client projects?
items.a: The Pack covers unlimited personal and client projects, forever, with no attribution and no per-site licence.

items.q: Which frameworks does it come in?
items.a: Every component in the Pack comes in plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript, React and Vue. Each one is set up through data-anm-* attributes, so you change timings, eases and distances without editing the source.

items.q: How do I get the code after buying?
items.a: Annnimate emails you right after checkout. You sign in with a 6-digit code, no password, and download the Pack as a ZIP from its page in your account. You can download it again any time.

Packs are final sale. The code is yours to download the moment the payment clears, so at checkout you confirm that this ends your right of withdrawal. The 14-day money-back guarantee covers the first Library payment only.

items.q: Is the Pack part of the Library?
items.a: All {packCount} Pack components are part of the Annnimate Library, which has {count} components and keeps growing. The Pack is those {packCount} on their own, for a one-time price; it does not include the rest of the Library.

items.q: I already have the Library. Do I need the Pack?
items.a: A Library member already has all {packCount} components, so the Pack adds nothing for you. It's for anyone who wants one landing page's worth of motion without a subscription.
